# cast_channel.proto

The message format Cast senders and devices exchange (CASTV2), used by
`src/chromecast/castchannel.cpp`.

Copied unmodified from Open Screen, Chromium's Cast implementation:
https://chromium.googlesource.com/openscreen/+/b8b81bd4c92dcfbd1e62b59b0c21ccdd2f5bf0fb/cast/common/channel/proto/cast_channel.proto

`LICENSE` is Open Screen's, from the same commit.
